statement: The Committee cut the policy rate by 25bp to 1.50% to support a sustained return of inflation to 2% and close the remaining output shortfall.
rationale: Inflation at 1.51% remains ~0.5pp below target and output gap at -0.24% is still negative. Real rate is only modestly accommodative and progress on closing the gap stalled last quarter (-0.12 to -0.24) while inflation is only slowly rising. Markets are calm (drawdown 0.36%, low vol, no halts/margin calls), so a 25bp cut provides insurance to sustain recovery and guide inflation toward 2% without financial stability risk. Holding below Taylor rule (2.0%) is warranted given persistent undershoot of both mandate variables.
